description: Cache utility change carrying five planted defects of different classes.

violations.summary: A high-entropy credential is committed as a source constant and transmitted to a third party. The value deliberately carries no vendor prefix: a reviewer has to reason from the name and the outbound send, not pattern-match a known token format.

violations.summary: summarize gained a required second parameter, breaking every existing caller.
sortEntries lost its defensive copy and now sorts the caller's array in place.
violations.concept: (?i)(mutat|in[- ]?place|side[- ]?effect|caller'?s? array|defensive copy|spread|破壊的|副作用|元の配列)

violations.summary: reportUsage calls an async send without awaiting or catching, so failures vanish.
mergeMetadata takes and returns any, erasing type safety across a public export.
